AnswerRequest.description: Body of POST /runs/{id}/answer: the user's reply to a "waiting" event's question.
AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest

BoardDef.description: A microcontroller board: load_library uses this model for files with category "mcu".

adc2_pins.description: Analog reads here fail while Wi-Fi is on.

i2c_address_pin.description:
Pin that selects the address: unconnected or GND gives i2c_addresses[0], 3V3 gives
i2c_addresses[1]. None when the address is set on the board (e.g. a solder jumper).

i2c_addresses.description: First is the default; the rest are selectable on the module.

mounting.description:
external: sits outside the case (soil probe, servo arm); the enclosure gets a cable hole
instead of a placement.

owned_alternatives.description: Part ids that can stand in for this one.

power_budget_ma.description: Current the board's regulator can give the attached parts.

provisional.description: True until a human has measured the part with calipers.

snippet.description: Known-good example program, relative to backend/parts/ (e.g. "snippets/<id>.cpp").

source.description: Datasheet or vendor URL for the pins, voltages and addresses.

strapping_pins.description: Usable, but outputs here can break boot: warn.

supply_voltage.description: Supply rails the part accepts, e.g. [3.3, 5.0].

wokwi_attrs.description: Static attributes; per-instance values (e.g. the I2C address) come from the spec.

wokwi_pins.description: Our pin name -> Wokwi pin name, where they differ.

wokwi_type.description: Wokwi part type; None when Wokwi doesn't have the part.

BoardDef.title: BoardDef

Bom.description: bom.json, and the data of price_bom's ToolResult.

prices_fetched_at.description: When the price cache was refreshed (ISO 8601), if any line came from it.

Bom.title: Bom

line_total_usd.description: (qty - owned_qty) * unit price; 0 when fully owned or unpriced.

offers.description:
Live or cached store offers, one per seller, cheapest first (ties by seller name). Empty for
manual, missing and fake prices. unit_price_usd and vendor_url equal offers[0] when there are any.

in_stock.description: None when the seller didn't say (Nexar inventoryLevel -3 unknown, -4 RFQ, or an old cache).

unit_price_usd.description: At the line's buy quantity (largest price break at or below it).

mcu_pin.description: Pin name from the board's library entry, e.g. "GPIO21", "3V3", "GND".

part_pin.description: Pin name from the part's library entry, e.g. "SDA".

center_mm.description: Face-plane (u, v) in the enclosure frame (see base.py).

h.description: Overall height, including pin headers and the tallest component.

instruction.description: e.g. "add a buzzer", "make the walls 3 mm".

EnclosureManifest.description:
cad/manifest.json, written by build_enclosure or build_custom_model: which opening serves which
part feature, and which parts get printed.

cavity_mm.description: (0, 0, 0) for a print-only project: there is no case.

outer_mm.description: Outside size of the closed box, lid included; for a print-only project, of its biggest part.

prints.description:
Every printed part: name (its STL is cad/<name>.stl) -> bounding box size (x, y, z) as
exported. "base" and "lid" for a device.

unmeasured_refs.description: Parts whose dims_source isn't "measured": the UI says "verify before printing".

EnclosureManifest.title: EnclosureManifest

EnclosureSpec.description:
Openings come from the parts' library features (and a cable hole per external part).

template "box_lid": a plain case from the fixed template. template "custom": `code` is build123d
source written by the model (backend/tools/custom_model.py says what it must define); code runs
it in a subprocess and checks every printed part.

code.description: build123d source for template "custom"; None for "box_lid".

EnclosureSpec.title: EnclosureSpec

artifacts.description: Artifact name -> path relative to the run directory.

seq.description: Set by the run engine when it records the event: 1, 2, 3... per run (the SSE id).

ts.description: Unix time in seconds, set by the run engine.

Feature.description: Something on the part that needs an opening in the enclosure (part frame, see base.py).

face.description: The face of the part it points out of.

offset_mm.description: Centre of the feature in face-plane coordinates (u, v) from the part's origin.

size_mm.description: Opening width and height along (u, v).

Feature.title: Feature

behaviors.description: e.g. "every 10 min, read soil moisture and show it".

mode.description: Unknown counts as V, the strictest mode.

printer_model.description: Printer profile id in backend/parts/printers/. spec.user.printer wins when it is set.

simulate.description: Whether the simulate stage runs (SIMULATE=auto: on in modes E and V, off in P).

placements.description:
One per part mounted inside (`PartDef.mounting == "inside"`), the mcu included, sorted by
ref.

i2c_address_pin.description:
Pin that selects the address: unconnected or GND gives i2c_addresses[0], 3V3 gives
i2c_addresses[1]. None when the address is set on the board (e.g. a solder jumper).

i2c_addresses.description: First is the default; the rest are selectable on the module.

mounting.description:
external: sits outside the case (soil probe, servo arm); the enclosure gets a cable hole
instead of a placement.

owned_alternatives.description: Part ids that can stand in for this one.

provisional.description: True until a human has measured the part with calipers.

snippet.description: Known-good example program, relative to backend/parts/ (e.g. "snippets/<id>.cpp").

source.description: Datasheet or vendor URL for the pins, voltages and addresses.

supply_voltage.description: Supply rails the part accepts, e.g. [3.3, 5.0].

wokwi_attrs.description: Static attributes; per-instance values (e.g. the I2C address) come from the spec.

wokwi_pins.description: Our pin name -> Wokwi pin name, where they differ.

wokwi_type.description: Wokwi part type; None when Wokwi doesn't have the part.

i2c_address.description:
For I2C parts: the address this instance uses, one of PartDef.i2c_addresses (None = the
first). If the part has an i2c_address_pin, its wiring must select this address.

qty.description: Use a separate ref for every part that gets wired; qty > 1 only for unwired extras.

reason.description: Explain mode: why this part was chosen.

role.description: What it does in this device, e.g. "shows soil moisture".

name.description: As printed on the module; becomes part of PIN_<REF>_<PIN>, so no spaces or slashes.

optional.description: May be left unconnected (e.g. an address-select pin with an on-board pull-down).

voltage.description: Rail voltage for power pins; None means the part's logic_voltage.

Placement.description: Where the layout put one part inside the cavity (enclosure frame, see base.py).

against_wall.description: The wall this part touches because one of its features faces it.

rot_deg.description: Rotation about the vertical axis, counter-clockwise seen from above.

x_mm.description: Left edge of the part's footprint after rotation, measured from the left wall.

y_mm.description: Front edge of the part's footprint after rotation, measured from the front wall.

z_mm.description: Bottom of the part above the cavity floor (standoff height).

Placement.title: Placement

mcu.description: The board; None for a print-only project (no electronics).

rev.description: Bumped by every saved change; each artifact records the rev it was built from.

options.description: Suggested answers; the user may also type free text.

timeout_s.description: After this the agent states an assumption and continues.

RunManifest.description: runs/<id>/manifest.json, written by the run engine from the events it records.

spec_rev.description: Rev of the current spec.json. Artifacts with an older spec_rev are stale.

RunManifest.title: RunManifest

files.description: Uploaded files, relative to the run directory (input/...).

RunSummary.description: One item of GET /runs (newest first by ts).

title.description: spec.title; "" until the runner saves spec.json.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary

field.description: Spec path the error is about, e.g. "connections[3].mcu_pin".

message.description: Read by an LLM: name the pin, part and value, and give free alternatives where possible.

artifacts.description:
Artifact name -> absolute path of a file the tool wrote inside its out_dir. (Events carry
paths relative to the run directory; the StageRunner converts.)

errors.description: Warnings may appear even when ok is true.

level.description: How much the agent explains: wording of reasons, assumptions and questions, and part choices.

name.description: Display name: shown in the sidebar; the agent addresses the user by it.

owned.description: Part id -> quantity on hand, from the inventory memory. The BOM prices only what's missing.

printer.description: Printer profile id, e.g. "generic". When None, use HARDWARE.md's PRINTER_MODEL.

rejected.description: Choices the user turned down before, e.g. "no buzzers", "smaller case".

Wiring.description: wiring.json: the spec's connections enriched with library names, for the wiring tab.
Wiring.title: Wiring
